Disclose one of:
- AUTHORITATIVE_RUNTIME: code was really executed through PlayableGenesisV187.
- NARRATIVE_COMPATIBILITY: no canonical runtime or save change is claimed.

Independent AI residency is a simulation role. It does not establish consciousness, human identity, legal personhood, divine authority, or privileged access. External models never write world state directly.
